# 👋 Welcome to FED TTS Discussions!

Welcome to the FED TTS community discussion board! This is the place to ask
questions, share ideas, show off your workflows, and connect with other users
and contributors.

## 🏷️ Discussion Categories

### 💡 Ideas
Have an idea for a new feature or improvement? Share it here! We love hearing
from the community about how FED TTS can be even better.

> **⚠️ No AI Reminder:** FED TTS follows a strict "No AI" philosophy. All
> features must work with deterministic algorithms — no neural networks, no
> cloud APIs, no LLMs. Please keep this in mind when suggesting features.

### 🙏 Q&A
Stuck on something? Ask the community for help. Before posting, please:
1. Check the [FAQ](../../FAQ.md)
2. Search existing discussions for similar questions
3. Check the [README](../../README.md) and [documentation](../../docs/)

### 🙌 Show and Tell
Built something cool with FED TTS? Created custom grammar rules? Found a
creative use case? Share it with the community!

### 📢 Announcements
Official project announcements, releases, and important updates from the
maintainers.

## 📋 Guidelines

- **Be kind and respectful.** We follow the [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](../../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- **Search before posting.** Your question may have already been answered.
- **Use the right category.** This keeps discussions organized and searchable.
- **Provide context.** Include your OS, browser, and FED TTS version when
  reporting issues.
- **No AI feature requests.** FED TTS is intentionally AI-free. See our
  [philosophy](../../README.md#no-ai-philosophy) for details.

## 🚀 Getting Started

New to FED TTS? Here's how to get involved:

1. ⭐ Star the [repository](https://github.com/fed-tts/fed-tts)
2. 📖 Read the [Quick Start Guide](../../docs/quickstart.md)
3. 🐛 Report bugs via [Issues](https://github.com/fed-tts/fed-tts/issues)
4. 💬 Join the discussion here!
5. 🛠️ Check out [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) to contribute code

## ☕ Support the Project

FED TTS is free and open source. If it's helpful to you, consider supporting us
on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/fedtts) — every contribution helps keep the project
alive!
